content: Malongi ma Yesu kikuma kya kufwa kwa longu

Yesu buna kákatuka hahana, wisa ku kinzunga kya Yuteya yi kuna sambwa dikwawu dya Yolutani. Milumba-lumba mya batu myákhokama hika bela-bela yi yandi; bwosu kyákala kikalulu kyandi, wáyandika mu kubalonga.
Bafwadisi bisa muhyula, ndangu bamuleya. Bámuhyula: «Yakala kenina yi muswa wa kuyambula mukhetu wandi?»
Yesu wábavutwala: «Khi mutsiku káluheka Moyize?»
Bawu bázimbula: «Moyize wáhana muswa wa kusonikina mukanda wa kufwa kwa longu yi wa kukula.»
Yesu wubazimbwadini: «Moyize, kikuma kya mbundu ya tadi yina lwenina yawu, káluhekila mutsiku wuna."
Kaasi ku luyandiku lwa phangamu, Nzambi kábahanga yakala yi mukhetu.
"Kikuma kya bwabuna, yakala kasísa tata wandi yi ngudi wandi amana kadínama yi mukhetu wandi,
amana bawu bodi bakítuka mutu mosi." Yihana ni beku hika bodi kaasi mutu
mosi.
Mutu kahambulaku kina kakhundikisini Nzambi.»
Buna bátula ku nzu, balonguki bámuhyula hika byufu kikuma kya dyambu meni dina.
Yesu wábazimbwala: «Wuna wayámbula mukhetu wandi amana kakwela wahika, wuti mbongi ku thwala wuna watheti;
amana yuka ni mukhetu kadihambula yi yakala dyandi amana kakwela wahika, wuti mbongi.»
Yesu wusakumuni bana bakhunda
Batu bakala munatina bana ndangu kabasimba kuna moku, kaasi balonguki bakala bakaya.
Mu kumona bwabuna, Yesu wáyuka khabu amana wábazimbwala: «Yambulenu bana bakhunda bisa kwena meni! Lubakandisaku, mukuma Kipfumu kya Nzambi kyenina kikuma kya batu bana benina hanga bawu.
Abwabuna, yiluzimbwadi: wosu wuna wakonda yamba Kipfumu kya Nzambi hanga mwana wakhunda, kakótamwoku.»
Kunima wábazangula muna moku mandi amana wábasakumuna mu kubathetikaka moku.
Yesu yi Mutu wa mvwama
Bwosu kakala kwenda muna nzila, yakala mosi wísa thinu amana wáfukama kuna thwala ya Yesu mu kumuhyula: «Mulongi wa bukheti, biki pfwani yihanga mu kuvwa luzingu lwa mvula yi mvula?»
Yesu wámuzimbwala: «Kikuma kya biki wuthedidini wa bukheti? Heku mutu wenina wa bukheti ho ka Nzambi lwesi ku.
Wuzayi mitsiku myami: "Wuhondaku mvumbi ya khengu, wutaku mbongi, wuyibaku, wutaku kimbangi kya bukamvi, wuhunaku musamu, zitisa tata waku yi ngudi waku.»
Yandi wumuvutwadini: «Mulongi, mambu mana mosu yisima zitisa tukidila kileki kyama.»

Yesu wámutala amana wámutonda, wumuzimbwadini: «Kima kimosi kikukondini: ndawenda, tekisa byosu bina wenina byawu, hanabya kwena batsukamini, amana watámbula kuvwa ku zilu; kunima nzawisa amana ndanda.»
Kaasi yandi buna káyuka ndinga meni yina, kiwayi kyámukwata amana wénda mu kyadi, mukuma bima bya lawu kákala byawu.
Yesu buna kátala muna kabeta kandi, wuzimbudini kwena balonguki bandi: «Phasi bwenina kwena bana benina yi bimvwama mu kukota mu Kipfumu kya Nzambi!»
Balonguki báyituka lawu kikuma kya ndinga zandi. Kaasi Yesu wávutwakila: «Bana bama, phasi
bwenina mu kukota mu Kipfumu kya Nzambi!
Bweku phasi kwena kamela mu kulobuka ha hundu dya ndongu, kaasi phasi lawu kwena mvwama mu kukota mu Kipfumu kya Nzambi.»
Balonguki báyituka hika lawu, bakala dihyula bawu yi bawu: «Amana nati walenda huluka?»
Yesu wábatala amana wuzimbudini: «Mana malendakanaku kwena batu, malendakana kwena Nzambi; mukuma heku dyambu dyakonda lendakana kwena Nzambi.»
Phetelu wáyandika mu kumuzimbwala: «Tala betu, tusisini bima byetu byosu amana tulandi ngeyi.»
Yesu wávutula: «Abwabuna, yiluzimbwadibwa: heku mutu wásisa nzu, baphangi ba bayakala, baphangi ba bakhetu, ngudi, tata, bana kondilo mafu, kikuma kya meni yi kikuma kya Musamu wa Bukheti;
amana kakonda tambula mbala khama
buthwena bwabu: nzu, baphangi ba bayakala, baphangi ba bakhetu, bangudi, bana, yi mafu yi munyanga phi; amana muna tsi yina yakwísa, kakonda tambula moya wa mvula yi mvula.
Lawu bakala batheti, basúkinina amana lawu bakala batsuka, batékila.»
Yesu wusamuni mu mbala ya tatu lufwa lwandi yi lufutumuku lwandi

Mu nzila bákala mu kutombuka ku Yelusalemi. Amana Yesu kakala kwenda ku thwala ya bawu. Balonguki mu tsumbi bákala, bana bakala mulanda phi, bweya bakala bwawu. Yesu wábonga hika bawu kumi yi bodi, bela-bela yi yandi, amana wáyandika mu kubazimbwala mambu mama makhana mubwila.
Kábazimbwala: «Talenu, ku Yelusalemi tubati tombuka; Mwana wa mutu bamúlambula kwena bambuta ba banganga Nzambi yi kwena balongi ba mitsiku. Ndola ya lufwa bamúzengila, bamúlambula kwena baphani.
Bamúseya, bamúlokwala metya, bamúzyatula amana bamúhonda. Amana kunima bilumbu bitatu, kafútumuka.»
Kilomba kya Zyaki yi Yowani
Bana ba Zebeteya bodi, Zyaki yi Yowani, bísa muzimbwala: «Mulongi, twazóla ni wahanga kikuma kya betu mana twakúlomba.»
Yandi wubahyudini: «Biki luzodi ni yihanga kikuma kya benu?»
Bawu bamuzimbwadini: «Tuheka nzila ni twazakala mosi kuna koku dyaku dya kitata, mukwawu kuna koku dyaku dya kimama muna khembu yaku.»
Kaasi Yesu wubazimbwadini: «Lwisiku zaya mambu mana lwisi lomba. Lwalenda kunwa bungu dyadi yinwa meni, kondi loni kutambula mbotika yayi yitámbula meni?»
Bawu bamuzimbwadini: «Twalendabwa.» Yesu wubavutwadini: «Bungu dyadi nzodi yinwa meni, lwanwádya, amana balubotika phi mu mbotika yayi yitámbula meni.
Kaasi mana matadidini kuzakala ku kitata kyama holo ku kimama kyama, ka meni ku yisima hana; bifulu bina byenina kikuma kya bana báyidikilabya.»
Kumi bana bahika báyuka bwabuna, hanga babafungidi khabu Zyaki yi Yowani.
Yesu wábatela amana wubazimbwadini: «Luzayi ni malemba ma makanda bisi yala batu hanga bapfumu, amana bambuta bisi songila kwena bakwawu hamu dya bawu.
Dyeku buna mu kati dya benu, kaasi wuna wazola, mu kati dya benu, kukituka mbuta, kakála musadi wenu,
amana wosu wuna wuzodi kukala watheti mu kati dya benu, kakála muhika wa batu boosu.
Mukuma keti yandi meni Mwana wa mutu kísaku ndangu bamusadila, kaasi kikuma kya kusadila yi kulambula luzingu lwandi mu phila ya kukatula batu balawu mu kihika.»
Yesu wubukini phofu Balatimeya

Bisi ku Yediko. Amana buna kálubuka Yesu mu Yediko, yi balonguki bandi yi mulumba-lumba wa batu, phofu mosi wakala lomba bima muna nzila, khumbu yandi Balatimeya, mwana wa Timeya, kákala wazakala kuna kabeta ka nzila.
Wáyuka ni wuna Yesu mwisi Nazaleti amana wáyandika kukalunga: «Yesu, Mwana wa Tavidi, ngyukila kyadi!»
Balawu bakala mukaya ndangu kadibata, kaasi yandi wákalunga hika ngolu: «Mwana wa Tavidi, ngyukila kyadi!»
Yesu wátelema amana wuzimbudini: «Mutelenu.» Bámutela phofu yi kumuzimbwalaka: «Sya kikesa, telema, kabati kutela.»
Wálosa muzaka wandi, wátelama mbala mosi amana wísa kuna kákala Yesu.
Yesu wámuhyula: «Biki wuzodi yikuhangila?» Phofu wámuzimbwala: «Mulongi, nzodi yimona hika.»
Yesu wámuzimbwala: «Ndawenda, lukwikilu lwaku lukuhuludini
.» Muna tangwa meni dina, wáyandika kumona, amana wámulanda muna nzila.

footnotes.text: Masonuku mahika meku yi mihowu myami, kaasi mya kuhingisa mu mihowu myahika: "mu kukhundakana kwena mukhetu wandi".
Phasi: masonuku mahika mabati hana tsikiningi ni kwena babana bisi dihana mu bimvwama.
Khama yibati songila lufutu luna lwa mbuta kahána Nzambi kwena bana bisi musadila muna phila meni yayi.
